channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Josh Giddey | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Josh Giddey from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tiago Splitter on Buddy Hield, Tre Jones, Nic Claxton, Josh Giddey, Matas Buzelis, Caleb Wilson
item.description:
coach Tiago Splitter said of Hield’s role.

“You’re open, shoot it. When you surround your team with gravity like those guys (Hield and Powell), it opens it up for Caleb (Wilson), Matas (Buzelis) to get to the paint, for Nic (Claxton), for Tre (Jones), Josh (Giddey) – they’re all going to play in the paint.”

Tiago Splitter on Buddy Hield, Tre Jones, Nic Claxton, Josh Giddey, Matas Buzelis, Caleb Wilson, Sep 30, 2026. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Nikola Vucevic on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Guard Zach LaVine compared Giddey to Ricky Rubio, while veteran big man Nikola Vucevic has raved about how perfectly Giddey fits into what they want to do offensively.

“I think [Giddey’s] playmaking is huge and a thing that is going to help us a lot,”

Nikola Vucevic on Josh Giddey, Oct 27, 2024. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Canada's Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on facing his now former OKC Thunder teammate, Australia's Josh Giddey, at the Olympics tomorrow:

“I know his game like the back of my hand, and I'm sure he knows mine the same way. It's going to be a fun matchup.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Josh Giddey, Jul 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Arturas Karnisovas on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Bulls VP Arturas Karnisovas on choosing Josh Giddey over draft picks:

“It's hard to acquire players this young, this productive, that early in their careers…we thought that was the price to pay for Josh”

Arturas Karnisovas on Josh Giddey, Jun 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @JamalCollier.

item.title: Sam Presti on Josh Giddey, Nikola Topic
item.description:
Sam Presti on comparing Topić to Giddey:

“I wouldn’t compare him specifically to Josh or any other player.. Guys that are big for their position that process the game well… we value those skill sets.. I don’t think you have enough players who can make decisions on the court.”

Sam Presti on Josh Giddey, Nikola Topic, Jun 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Sam Presti on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Sam Presti:

“Josh Giddey has been the ultimate professional.. Ultimately, I think his dream and vision is to lead a team. I think that's realistic, but that probably wasn't going to happen here... This is going to be a good trade for everybody, in my opinion.”

Sam Presti on Josh Giddey, Jun 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Sam Presti on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Sam Presti on Josh Giddey:

“It was an up and down year. I think he would acknowledge that. He's 21. 21 year old's typically have up and down years... He got started quickly and as the team got better, he's seen some resistance with that.. The thing about Giddey that I respect is that he is tough and he is clutch. He's been asked to change some things... and he hasn't flinched one time.”

Sam Presti on Josh Giddey, May 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Jalen Williams on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Jalen Williams on how Josh Giddey handled his benching:

“There are a lot of guys in the NBA that could’ve made a really big deal out of that… He did a good job at buying into that…That’s really selfless and we appreciated him for that.”

Jalen Williams on Josh Giddey, May 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Jaylin Williams on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Jaylin Williams on Josh Giddey:

“Gidd’s my guy. He’ll forever be my guy.. I know he’s gone through a lot this year.. He was still a great teammate.. a great player.. I love playing with Gidd. He’s a great guy.”

Jaylin Williams on Josh Giddey, May 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey being benched last game:

“His confidence doesn’t really waver…He was very much in character the minute he went in. I don’t overly talk about it. I obviously had a conversation with him…It’s our job to try to explore the series and figure out the best path to 4 wins.”

Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey, May 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey’s first 2 games against the Mavs and what he’s seen from him against them:

“In terms of what I've seen, what I've seen is 3 years of Josh Giddey and he's a very good player, and a very important player to our team… I don't know that we close that (Pelicans) series if he's not getting the shots in the fourth quarter of that (Game 4).And so these games are high stakes, they're obviously emotional. But I think it's important with every player — good, bad, whatever — zoom out and see the big picture and big picture is he's been a very productive player for a long time. He's 21 years old. He's gonna be a very productive player.”

Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey, May 10, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey:

“He’s played really hard defensively… We had him on Murphy in Game 1. Last night he was on Murphy and a mix of Herb Jone and other guys… I felt last night offensively, he did a good job of helping us initiate the blender with early passes.”

Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey, Apr 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Mark Daigneault on Dallas aggressively leaving Josh Giddey open in spurts today:

“We’ve seen it all year, so it’s nothing new for us. We want to have a diversity of attacks against it.”

Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey, Feb 10, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:SGA on Josh Giddey:

“When he’s making decision and is aggressive, he’s a really good basketball player…He went through a little bit of a slump obviously. He’s worked at it, got better from it.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Josh Giddey, Jan 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Jalen Williams on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Jalen Williams:

“We trust Josh (Giddey) to make the right play. I don’t really think he’s hindering anything as far as offense. Mark kinda hit it on the head — we have so many options on the team and he can be effective in so many other ways.”

Jalen Williams on Josh Giddey, Dec 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey’s toughness:

“First of all, he’s fearless. I give him a lot of credit, he just doesn’t shrink on any situation…He’s always had that. I do think he’s got stronger and grown into his frame.”

Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey, Nov 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Josh Giddey, Jalen Williams
item.description:
Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on playing with Josh Giddey and Jalen Williams:

“I think the three of us are all getting better for sure. The three of us are a big part of the future here.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Josh Giddey, Jalen Williams, Mar 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Josh Giddey, Jalen Williams
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on the Thunder having 3 All-Star representatives in himself, Josh Giddey & Jalen Williams:

“Having three guys here is pretty good for our future. It means we’re heading in the right direction.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Josh Giddey, Jalen Williams, Feb 18, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Chauncey Billups on Josh Giddey:

“He has incredible feel. Plays the game very easy…He plays with a calmness I really like… I think he’s an excellent point guard.”

Chauncey Billups on Josh Giddey, Dec 21, 2022. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Chet Holmgren on his fit with OKC:

“I feel like I could fit in with almost anybody. But especially a point guard like Josh Giddey...he would make life easy for me. With Shai, he doesn't need any help from anybody. He's a hell of a player.”

Chet Holmgren on Josh Giddey, Jun 20, 2022. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: LeBron James on Sam Presti, Jeff Green, Serge Ibaka, Reggie Jackson, Josh Giddey
item.description:
“Josh Giddey is great. Sam Presti, I don’t understand this guy’s eye for talent. He drafted KD, Russ [Westbrook], Jeff Green, Serge Ibaka, Reggie Jackson, Josh Giddey and the list goes on and on and on. This guy is pretty damn good.”

LeBron James on Sam Presti, Jeff Green, Serge Ibaka, Reggie Jackson, Josh Giddey, Feb 20, 2022. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey:

“I haven’t said one thing to him about one turnover this season. Cause he’s got the guts to make the play.”

Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey, Nov 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey:

“His intelligence, feel and instincts, make sense when you see how he grew up.”

Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey, Oct 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Daigneault on starting Josh Giddey:

“Giddey is a rookie, but in camp he’s shown us what we’ve expected. He’s picked things up quickly.”

Mark Daigneault on Josh Giddey, Oct 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Sam Presti on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Presti on Josh Giddey:

“He played in a men's league the whole year. The competition he played against is equal to or better than the Summer League.”

Sam Presti on Josh Giddey, Sep 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Luc Longley on LaMelo Ball, Josh Giddey
item.description:
Three time NBA champ and current Australian national team assistant coach Luc Longley on Josh Giddey:

“I think his court vision and his spatial awareness and his understanding of the game is on the same level as LaMelo Ball. I'd be really surprised if he doesn't kick some ass.”

Luc Longley on LaMelo Ball, Josh Giddey, Jul 31, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Sam Presti on Josh Giddey
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Sam Presti on the fit with SGA and Giddey:

“I think it’s a credit to ShaiI because of the way he looks at the game. I think it’s a great fit.”

Sam Presti on Josh Giddey, Jul 31, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.
